thread:
Alex: Quick async check-in — SRE standup style (what I did / blockers / today)

Alex: What I did: triaged INC-7123 (5xx spike from apac-proxy), pushed a temporary alert rate-limit to reduce noise, and rolled a small redis client patch to canary. Updated the dashboard for prefix cache hit rates.

Alex: Blockers: APAC node is still flapping on disk_pressure. I suspect an old logrotate config filling /var/log; need infra to validate node-level scheduler. Also PR 432 (runbook edits for cache eviction) needs another review.

Alex: Today: finish runbook PR, follow up on the pager handover, review CR for continuous-batching perf tweaks, and confirm fallback routing policy for deduper.

Priya: thx Alex. can you drop the runbook link? also tagging @Carlos to look at the disk_pressure theory. :eyes:

Alex: https://confluence.internal/sre/runbooks/cache-eviction-v2 — added a TOC and a small cmd snippet for repro.

PagerBot: [pager] 1778882000 — Pager: APAC-proxy high-5xx-rate — routed to eng-sre oncall (Neha). Incident ID: PAGER-3891.

Neha: picked up the pager at 09:02 UTC. Warm restarted the proxy pod (no config change), latency dropped to normal but 99p latency still ~180ms vs 120ms baseline. Left the fallback route enabled to shift traffic away from the pod.

Neha: Observed disk i/o queue lengths high on node ip-10-2-37-9, I ran `du -sh /var/log/*` and saw a couple rotated files >2GB under /var/log/journal. Suspect old logrotate rule.

Sam: I can take node diagnostics. will try to repro locally and check journalctl retention. might be an upstream systemd config mismatch. tagging @Priya for infra ACLs if I need node ssh.

Carlos: I can help with the infra check after standup. If it's logrotate we should fix the cron job and add a metric to alert on /var disk used% before it hits 85%.

Priya: ACLs are fine for SRE group. Sam, ping me when you attempt ssh and I’ll shadow. Also +1 on a disk-usage alert, that would've prevented this.

Alex: PR 432 is at `sre/runbooks#432` — @Priya can you skim for clarity? small changes: add step to promote canary back if cache miss rate increases >5% within 10m.

Priya: will review in next 30m.

Sam: quick note on CR 441 (continuous-batching): left comments about KV cache lifetimes; looks good overall but needs a small tweak for cold-start mem usage. @Alex can you re-run the microbench after the tweak?

Alex: yup will re-run with the adjusted config and post numbers here.

Neha: handover: I’ll be oncall until 17:00 UTC. if anything urgent comes up ping me in this thread or @pager on mobile. left a short checklist in the incident channel about fallback states. :memo:

Carlos: filing a follow-up ticket to add disk-use alert and update logrotate: SRE-1285. Assigning to infra with recommended thresholds.

Priya: quick logistics: can we keep async standups like this during the week? saves a lot of context switching. perhaps one 15-min sync Mon if needed. :thumbsup:

Alex: agree — async + optional ad-hoc voice for hot incidents. No need for a meeting now.

Sam: started SSH on node ip-10-2-37-9, found old `/etc/logrotate.d` entry for `journal` that references a deprecated path. moving to fix and will restart the logrotate job.

Neha: thanks Sam — after fix can you run `systemctl status` and post the health checks?

Sam: will do, posting status in ~10m. :rocket:

Carlos: thumbs for follow-ups. I’ll link SRE-1285 to the incident and add a quick playbook entry for disk alerts.

Alex: awesome. if anyone needs me I’m on slack and reachable on mobile. otherwise will post PR merge + bench numbers here. :heavy_check_mark:
